verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe several documented extension formats that run on your own instance. Functions are modular Python plugins, and Tools, Functions, Pipes, Filters and Pipelines all execute your Python code on your server, with function types like adding a custom model. Skills are folders containing a SKILL.md file, and you can also plug in your own MCP servers or tool servers. Missing for 10: the cited snippets do not show the actual plugin code schema or the step-by-step upload/load workflow, and there is no independent hands-on report of building and loading a custom plugin (a community comment only mentions pipelines in passing).
